limits: One fixed-order matrix only; no identical control pair, repeated matrix, or A/A noise estimate.
The actual global physical-TPS metric is physical tokens in the measured window divided by the driver primary elapsed envelope, not the reciprocal of median host cadence.
The host boundary cadence is an interval between native Profiler.step returns; the adapter does not synchronize each update, and the last interval includes the end-boundary drain.
The compiler observer has partial coverage. Asynchronous worker completion and some native DeepGEMM JIT paths are unverified.
Historical SE Triton key changes do not establish whether a key was loaded from disk or compiled, nor when the change occurred within the run.
Logged loss values establish finite training only; they are not a numerical parity or convergence test.

compiler_and_cache.interpretation: Triton key appearance can be a disk-cache load or a new specialization; the observer does not establish compilation time or prove that JIT occurred.
limits: Asynchronous compiler workers may outlive the parent timing scope, so Inductor counters and Triton cache state provide partial evidence only.
Triton cache changes may represent a disk-cache load or specialization; any change conservatively opens the compilation gate.
DeepGEMM cache misses are rejected for the verified binary; runtime behavior was probed through m_grouped and k_grouped, while other native JIT paths remain unverified.
